edits.text: 3. MUTUAL CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep confidential the terms of this Agreement and shall not disclose them except: (a) as required by applicable law, regulation, legal process, or court order; (b) to that party’s legal, tax, accounting, or other professional advisers who need to know the information and are subject to professional or contractual confidentiality obligations; or (c) as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. For a disclosure under subsection (a), the disclosing party shall, to the extent legally permitted and reasonably practicable, give the other party advance written notice and disclose only what is legally required. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits lawful reporting to, communication with, or cooperation with a governmental or regulatory authority, or requires notice of such activity where notice is prohibited by law.
